subtasks.title: Orchestration-flow Layer 1/2 filtering in claude-md-filter.ts
subtasks.prompt:
Implement O-15's two new filtering layers against the "### Orchestration flow" section, per PLAN.md sections 1 and 3.

1. In src/bun/stage-handoff.ts: add `export` to the existing private `inLane` function (do not change its logic) and extend its doc comment to note it is now also used by claude-md-filter.ts (O-15) for directory-prefix path-overlap checks, so the two call sites can never drift apart.

2. In src/bun/claude-md-filter.ts: add `ORCHESTRATION_FLOW_HEADING`, the `ITEM_MARKER_RE`/`OrchestrationItem`/`locateOrchestrationItems` numbered-item parser, Layer 1 (`cutOrchestrationFlowStageGate`, dropping items 5+ wholesale, fail-open if item 5 isn't found), Layer 2 (`FILTERABLE_ITEM_TITLES` = {"Task context menu", "Tasks from issues", "Shared task-composition modules", "`@` file references"}, `HINT_RE`, `extractPathHints`, `pathsOverlap` (using the newly-exported `inLane` from stage-handoff.ts, both directions), `cutOrchestrationFlowOverlap`), and extend `FilterPipelineContext`/`filterClaudeMdForPipeline`'s options with optional `pipelineStage`, `isChild`, `files` fields (each defaulting to a no-op so every existing 2-arg `{ agentKind }` call keeps behaving identically) plus `shouldDropOrchestrationFlowSection` and `ORCHESTRATION_DROP_STAGES` = {specify, clarify, planning, plan-review, decompose}. Wire both layers into `filterClaudeMdForPipeline` exactly as PLAN.md's §3 code shows — Layer 1 takes precedence over Layer 2 when both could apply. Every new function must be pure, try/catch-wrapped, and return the input unchanged when it can't locate what it's looking for.

3. Extend src/bun/claude-md-filter.test.ts per PLAN.md §5: a second fixture with a synthetic "### Orchestration flow" section (items 1-4 short/always-kept, items 5-8 and 13 filler never eligible for Layer 2, items 9-12 using the four exact filterable titles with distinctive backtick `/`-paths), followed by a sibling heading. Cover: Layer 1 drop for all five drop-stages and keep for the four keep-groups (code-review, testing, building, isChild:true); Layer 2 discriminating drop/keep behavior including a mixed case where one filterable item overlaps and the others don't; files=[]/undefined keeps everything; a filterable-titled item with no backtick `/` hints is always kept; items 1-8/13 are never affected by any files value even under a coincidental textual match. Add a direct-import parity check asserting `inLane`'s documented cases (`inLane("a/b.ts","a")` true, `inLane("a.ts","b")` false, `inLane("a","a")` true) via a comment noting this is sufficient because claude-md-filter.ts imports this exact function. Do not modify any existing test in the file.

Run `bun test src/bun/claude-md-filter.test.ts` and `bun run typecheck` before finishing.

subtasks.title: Wire stage/file signals into resolvePipelineSystemPromptFile
subtasks.prompt:
Wire O-15's filtering layers (already implemented in src/bun/claude-md-filter.ts, which exports an extended `FilterPipelineContext`/`filterClaudeMdForPipeline` accepting optional `pipelineStage`/`isChild`/`files`) into the orchestrator, per PLAN.md sections 2 and 4.

1. In src/bun/build-scheduler.ts: extract the subtask-files lookup currently inlined at the `onlyPaths: subtask.files.length > 0 ? subtask.files : undefined` computation into a new exported pure function `subtaskFilesForChild(parent: Task, subtaskId: string): string[] | null` exactly as shown in PLAN.md §2 (reads and parses the parent's TASKS.json via `parseBuildPlan`, returns null on any read/parse/lookup failure or an empty `files` array, never throws). Update the existing `onlyPaths` call site to use `subtaskFilesForChild(parent, subtask.id) ?? undefined` instead of the inline ternary — same observed behavior, single source of truth.

2. In src/bun/orchestrator.ts: import `subtaskFilesForChild` from `./build-scheduler.ts`. Add `parseReviewDiffStatPaths(stat: string): string[]` (parses `git diff --stat` lines, including rename and brace-rename forms, skipping unparseable lines) and `pipelineOverlapFiles(task: Task, extras: StageExtras | null): string[] | null` exactly per PLAN.md §4 (child tasks resolve via `subtaskFilesForChild`; code-review tasks resolve via `extras?.reviewDiff?.stat` parsed through `parseReviewDiffStatPaths`; every other case, including testing/building, returns null — no new git/diff call is added for those two stages). Extend `resolvePipelineSystemPromptFile` with an optional 4th `ctx` parameter (`{ pipelineStage?, isChild?, files? }`, default `{}`) that is threaded into `filterClaudeMdForPipeline`'s options — every existing 3-arg call/test must keep compiling and behaving identically. Wire the call site inside `startTaskInner` (~line 1534-1537, where `task` and `extras` are already in scope) to pass `{ pipelineStage: task.pipelineStage, isChild: task.parentTaskId != null, files: pipelineOverlapFiles(task, extras) }`.

3. Extend src/bun/orchestrator-pipeline.test.ts near the existing O-14 section per PLAN.md §5: tests for `subtaskFilesForChild` (present files, empty/omitted files, unknown subtaskId, missing/invalid TASKS.json — all returning the documented null/array); `parseReviewDiffStatPaths` (plain line, rename, brace-rename, malformed line skipped); `pipelineOverlapFiles` (child resolves via subtaskFilesForChild, code-review resolves via reviewDiff.stat, testing/building return null); `resolvePipelineSystemPromptFile`'s 4-arg form with a full-shaped fixture CLAUDE.md (specify drops items 5-13; code-review with non-overlapping files drops only the four filterable items; testing/building with no files keeps everything; building+isChild with partially-overlapping files keeps only the overlapping one); and an end-to-end spawn test extending the existing O-14 pattern for a build-child task whose TASKS.json subtask.files don't overlap src/mainview/**, asserting the written .agetor/CLAUDE.filtered.md reflects the drop, plus a testing-stage spawn keeping all four items. Do not weaken or delete any existing O-14 test in this file.

Run `bun test src/bun/orchestrator-pipeline.test.ts src/bun/orchestrator-pipeline-guards.test.ts` and `bun run typecheck` before finishing.

subtasks.title: Document O-15 in pipeline-token-efficiency.md

Cover: what shipped (Layer 1 stage gate dropping items 5-13 wholesale for the five non-source-touching stages, plus Layer 2 files-overlap filter scoped to the four filterable items — "Task context menu", "Tasks from issues", "Shared task-composition modules", "`@` file references" — both added inside claude-md-filter.ts and wired through the same resolvePipelineSystemPromptFile call site as O-14); state explicitly that both layers are gated by the existing AGETOR_PIPELINE_CLAUDE_MD_FILTER switch with no new switch added, since that switch already fully gates filterClaudeMdForPipeline before either new layer runs; spell out the five-stage (specify/clarify/planning/plan-review/decompose) vs four-group (code-review/testing/building/build-child) split; call out the testing/building asymmetry as an intentional, non-goal-documented design boundary (no per-turn file signal exists for those two stages today, so items 9-12 stay unfiltered there by design); include a measured byte-saving figure for a representative child-build turn — run `bun test src/bun/orchestrator-pipeline.test.ts -t "O-15"` (or the relevant new end-to-end spawn test from the orchestrator-wiring subtask) and pull the actual before/after byte counts of the "### Orchestration flow" section from its output or from a quick manual probe against the written .agetor/CLAUDE.filtered.md, and report the real percentage — do not fabricate a number; restate the kill switch (AGETOR_PIPELINE_CLAUDE_MD_FILTER=0, unchanged behavior when off, same as O-14).
